extension.summary: Your Navidrome library, and navifind's extras
Ta bibliothèque Navidrome, et les extras de navifind
extension.description: Resonuls on Kodi: browse and play a Navidrome (Subsonic) server. Behind a navifind proxy it also plays YouTube, files what you listen to in the library, and keeps one account playing in one place: start music on your phone and Kodi pauses.

Resonuls sur Kodi : parcours et écoute un serveur Navidrome (Subsonic). Derrière un proxy navifind, il lit aussi YouTube, range ce que tu écoutes dans la bibliothèque et garde un compte, une musique : lance une musique sur ton téléphone et Kodi se met en pause.
extension.news: 0.2.0: the home of covers is an app, with its lists and search in windows of its own, what plays at the top (pause, stop, next) and a Close button. YouTube is a screen of covers with its die, which deals new songs in your taste. The Resonuls program add-on opens the app from a skin's main menu.

extension.summary: Opens the Resonuls app, on its own
extension.description: The Resonuls app full screen, apart from Kodi's music: its home of covers, its lists and its search, with what plays at the top. Pick it for an entry of your skin's main menu.

L'app Resonuls en plein écran, à part de la musique de Kodi : son accueil de pochettes, ses listes et sa recherche, avec ce qui joue en haut. Choisis-la pour une entrée du menu principal de ton habillage.
extension.news: 1.0.1: a background of its own, resources/fanart.jpg, to pick for the skin's menu entry.

extension.summary: Resonuls for Kodi, kept up to date
Resonuls pour Kodi, toujours à jour
extension.description: Installs the Resonuls add-on and brings its new versions as they come out.
Installe l'add-on Resonuls et apporte ses nouvelles versions dès qu'elles sortent.
